preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w <= 10**12 for w in weights)
preconditions.description: All edge weights must be between 1 and 10^12.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 600,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= 2*n and 1 <= v <= 2*n and u != v for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: All query vertices must be within the range of 1 to 2n and must be distinct.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly q integers, one for each query.
All output integers must be non-negative, representing valid path lengths.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i]) == shortest_path_length(queries[i]) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: Each output integer must correspond to the shortest path length for the respective query.
